defs.def: the amount of sth that exists in a particular situation at a particular time （某时某情况下存在的）数量，程度，浓度

ex.s: The researchers examined various levels of noise on participants as they completed tests of creative thinking.
ex.t: 研究者在完成创造性思维测试时考察了参与者所承受的各种程度的噪音。

ex.s: Indeed, the researchers found that face-to-face interactions and conversations affect the creative process, and yet a coworking space or a coffee shop provides a certain level of noise while also providing freedom from interruptions.
ex.t: 事实上，研究人员发现，面对面的互动和交流会影响创造过程，而联合办公空间或咖啡馆在提供一定程度噪音的同时，也让人免受打扰。

ex.s: The GPNP’s main goal is to improve connectivity between separate ___62___ (population)and homes of giant pandas, and ___63___ (eventual)achieve a desired level of population in the wild.
ex.t: GPNP的主要目标是改善分散的大熊猫___62____（population 种群）和栖息地之间的连通性，并___63____（eventual 最终）实现理想的野生种群数量水平。

ex.s: More research is needed to see if improved fitness could have a positive effect on the risk of dementia and also to look at when during a lifetime a high fitness level is most important. " She also admitted that a relatively small number of women were studied, all of whom were form Sweden, so the results might not be applicable to other groups.
ex.t: 需要更多的研究来了解改善的健康状况是否对痴呆症风险有积极影响，以及在一生的哪个阶段高健康水平最重要。”她也承认研究的女性数量相对较少，且都来自瑞典，所以结果可能不适用于其他群体。

ex.s: With these main reasons in mind, we can evaluate our level of anger throughout the day and prevent cases of outbursts by comprehending the reasons for our feelings.
ex.t: 牢记这些主要原因，我们就能评估自己一整天愤怒的程度，并通过理解情绪背后的原因来防止爆发。

ex.s: With a different theme each year, the day Is observed with a wide range of events that are organised at local, national and international levels.
ex.t: 每年的主题不同，这一天通过在地方、国家和国际层面组织的各种活动来纪念。

ex.s: Although parks of all sizes and types exist at any level, the national parks, in particular, tend ____41____ (catch) our attention because of their large size and variety.
ex.t: 虽然各种规模和类型的公园存在于各个层面，但国家公园因其面积广大和种类丰富而尤其____引人注目。

ex.s: We tend to forget that sea level is a product of technically and culturally determined assumptions.
ex.t: 我们往往忘记，海平面其实是由技术和文化因素决定的一系列假设的产物。

ex.s: Little do they know that as they do so, a burst of energy is sent up to street level to help charge an electric car.
ex.t: 他们不知道的是，就在此时，一股能量被送上街面，用来为一辆电动汽车充电。

defs.def: a particular standard or quality 标准；水平；质量；品级

ex.s: The research, carried out by scientists at the Columbia Climate School and other institutions, found that if the city maintains past species patterns in new plantings, isoprene production in Manhattan in coming decades will go up by about 140%, and resulting summer ozone levels as much as 30%.
ex.t: 这项由哥伦比亚气候学院及其他机构的科学家开展的研究发现，如果该市在新种植中沿用过去的树种模式，未来几十年曼哈顿的异戊二烯产量将上升约140%，由此导致的夏季臭氧水平最多将上升30%。

ex.s: Many people enjoy relaxing music in the evening prior to going to bed．____37____While the validity of the idea is still being assessed，the lowered stress can even be tied back to blood pressure．Similarly, according to researchers，listening to just 30 minutes of soft music every day may help with healthy blood sugar levels， through the lowering of stress and anxiety．
ex.t: 许多人喜欢在晚上睡前听放松的音乐。____37____虽然这种观点的有效性仍在评估中，但压力的降低甚至可能与血压有关。同样，根据研究人员的研究，每天只需听30分钟轻音乐，就可能通过减轻压力和焦虑，有助于维持健康的血糖水平。

ex.s: Most obviously, the men displayed lower blood sugar levels at the start of their workouts when they had skipped breakfast than when they had eaten.
ex.t: 最明显的是，那些跳过早餐的男性在锻炼开始时显示的血糖水平，比他们吃过早餐时要低。

ex.s: They displayed higher insulin levels.
ex.t: 他们显示出更高的胰岛素水平。

ex.t: Baggy已成为英国——也可能是全世界——第一只通过记录地面附近的污染物水平来参与对抗空气污染的狗。

ex.s: The differences between most of the groups were statistically insignificant; however,the participants in the 70 decibels group—those exposed to a level of noise similar to background chatter in a coffee shop-significantly outperformed the other groups.
ex.t: 大多数组别之间的差异在统计上并不显著；然而，暴露在70分贝（类似于咖啡馆背景聊天的噪音水平）下的那组参与者，表现明显优于其他组别。

ex.s: But in samples with less than 60 milligrams of calcium carbonate, boiling reduced the level of plastics by just 25 percent.
ex.t: 但在碳酸钙含量低于60毫克的样本中，煮沸仅将塑料的水平降低了25%。

ex.s: They raise the cortisol level.
ex.t: 它们会提高皮质醇水平。

ex.s: The right level of background noise may interrupt our normal patterns of thinking just enough to allow our imaginations to wander, without making it impossible to focus.
ex.t: 适当水平的背景噪音可能会恰到好处地打断我们正常的思维模式，让我们的想象力得以漫游，同时又不会让人无法集中注意力。

ex.s: Which level of background noise may promote creative thinking ability?
ex.t: 哪个水平的背景噪音可能促进创造性思维能力？

ex.s: Pairs are matched by languages of interest and proficiency levels.
ex.t: 配对根据兴趣语言和熟练水平进行匹配。

ex.s: Many people enjoy herbal tea because it can have a positive effect on energy levels.
ex.t: 许多人喜欢花草茶，因为它能对能量水平产生积极的影响。

ex.s: Fitness levels decide the quality of life.
ex.t: 健身水平决定生活质量。

ex.s: AI also significantly enhances the educational value of museums, particularly for children and families. _____39_____ For instance, interactive exhibits powered by AI can adjust their content and difficulty level based on the user's preferences and responses.
ex.t: 人工智能还显著提升了博物馆的教育价值，对儿童和家庭尤其如此。____39____例如，由人工智能驱动的互动展品可以根据用户的偏好和反应调整内容和难度水平。

ex.s: “Also, there is a lot of research showing that a positive mood leads to higher levels of productivity and creativity.
ex.t: 此外，大量研究表明，积极的心情能带来更高的生产力和创造力水平。

ex.s: They make me feel valued and respected, no matter my level of artistic ability.
ex.t: 无论我的艺术水平如何，他们都让我感到自己被重视、被尊重。

ex.s: High levels of knowledge can make people too attached to traditional ways of viewing problems across fields the arts, sciences, and politics.
ex.t: 高水平的知识可能使人们过于固守各领域（艺术、科学和政治）传统的思维方式。

ex.s: Changing levels of body chemicals called hormones not only make teenagers’ bodies develop adult characteristics, but also make it hard for teenagers to fall asleep before 11 pm.
ex.t: 被称为荷尔蒙的体内化学物质水平的变化，不仅使青少年的身体发育出成人特征，也使他们很难在晚上11点前入睡。

ex.s: A total of 40 women met the criteria for a high fitness level, or 120 watts or higher.
ex.t: 共有40名女性符合高健康水平标准，即120瓦特或以上。

ex.s: Often due to various pressures, we tend to ignore our health. ____35____ It is the fitness level of our body that helps us fight these diseases.
ex.t: 往往由于各种压力，我们倾向于忽视我们的健康。____35____正是我们身体的健康水平帮助我们抵抗这些疾病。

ex.s: Furthermore, around 50% of the world’s population live in regions where the figure is now below the replacement level (ie 2.1 births per woman) and almost all developed nations are experiencing sub-replacement birth rate.

ex.s: The results are mixed For football and basketball，adding talented players to a team proves a good method，but only up to the point where 70% of the players are top talent；above that level, the team’s performance begins to decline.
ex.t: 结果好坏参半。对于足球和篮球，给一支球队增加天才球员被证明是个好方法，但仅限于顶尖人才占到70%之前；超过那个水平，球队的表现就开始下降。

defs.def: a position or rank in a scale of size or importance 层次；级别

ex.t: 但房屋看护也提供了酒店找不到的___49____级别的体验。

ex.t: 所有全日制学生（包括本科在内）在有老师带领的团体中可享受每人2英镑的特殊优惠票价。

ex.s: There are different levels of exercises for different age groups and we must do them according to our own health and age.
ex.t: 不同年龄段有不同的运动级别，我们必须根据自己的健康状况和年龄来进行。

ex.s: You may pursue training, degrees, or increasing levels of responsibility at work.
ex.t: 你可以追求培训、学位或工作中不断增加的责任级别。

ex.s: Cold water was one thing, but this icy lake was a whole other level.
ex.t: 冷水是一回事，但这片冰湖完全是另一个级别。

ex.s: This camp takes creative license to an entirely new level.
ex.t: 这个营地将创作自由提升到了一个全新的层次。

ex.s: Beijing lowered its emergency response level.
ex.t: 北京下调了应急响应级别。

defs.def: a particular way of looking at, reacting to or understanding sth 看待（或应对、理解）事物的方式
the height of sth in relation to the ground or to what it used to be （与地面或过去位置相对的）高度

ex.s: The English youngster noticed that pollution levels are around two-thirds higher close to the ground than they are in the air at the height where they are recorded by the agency.
ex.t: 这位英国年轻人注意到，靠近地面的污染程度比该机构记录高度处的空气高出约三分之二。

ex.s: Her monitor has shown that air pollution levels are higher closer to ground level, which has helped highlight concerns that babies and young kids may be at higher risk of developing lung problems.
ex.t: 它的监测器显示，越接近地面，空气污染水平越高，这突显了一个令人担忧的问题：婴儿和幼儿患肺部疾病的风险可能更高。

ex.s: The idea of sea level as a reference point for elevations has by now been around for so long as to go essentially unnoticed-we mention it without even considering what it means.
ex.t: 以海平面作为海拔参照点的想法由来已久，以至于人们基本不再留意——我们提到它时甚至不会去想它意味着什么。

ex.s: The peak of Mount Qomolangma, 8,849 meters above sea level.
ex.t: 珠穆朗玛峰峰顶，海拔8849米。

ex.s: This is how I began my search for the conceptual history of sea level.
ex.t: 我就是这样开始探寻海平面的概念史的。

ex.s: In this book I examine three crucial stages in the history of mean sea level.
ex.t: 在本书中，我考察了平均海平面历史上的三个关键阶段。

ex.t: 《海平面：一段历史》

ex.s: In my early thirties, I decided to climb Mount Kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in Africa at 5, 895 meters above sea level.
ex.t: 在我三十岁出头时，我决定攀登乞力马扎罗山，这是非洲最高峰，海拔5895米。

ex.s: At 5, 700 meters, there’s only half the oxygen ______28______ in each breath compared to at sea level.
ex.t: 在5700米处，每次呼吸中的氧气含量只有海平面的一半____28____。

defs.def: a floor of a building; a layer of ground 楼层；地层

ex.s: Background information In Britain, the floor of a building at the bottom level is called the "ground floor" and the floor above it is called the "first floor".
ex.t: 背景信息：在英国，大楼最底层的楼面被称为ground floor，它上面一层被称为first floor。

defs.def: having a flat surface that does not slope 平的；平坦的

ex.s: But since the results at 70 decibels were significant, the study also suggests that the right level of background noise—not too loud and not total silence—may actually improve one’s creative thinking ability.
ex.t: 但由于70分贝的结果显著，这项研究也表明适当水平的背景噪音——不太响也不完全安静——实际上可能提高一个人的创造性思维能力。

ex.s: In the study, about 52 percent of the dads exhibited above-average levels of authoritative parenting. key finding is that over time, children raised by an authoritative father were significantly more likely to develop persistence, which leads to better outcomes in school.
ex.t: 在这项研究中，约52%的父亲表现出高于平均水平的权威型育儿。关键发现是，随着时间的推移，由权威型父亲抚养长大的孩子明显更有可能培养出持之以恒的品质，从而在学校取得更好的成绩。

defs.def: having the same height, position, value, etc. as sth 等高的；地位相同的；价值相等的

ex.s: It is believed that today's children and teenagers are consuming three times the recommended level of sugar, putting them at a higher risk of the disease.
ex.t: 据信，如今的儿童和青少年摄入的糖是推荐量的三倍，使他们面临更高的患病风险。

defs.def: having the same score as sb 得分相同
not showing any emotion; steady 平静的；冷静的；平稳的
to make sth flat or smooth 使平坦；使平整

ex.s: But he is also working at a far more fundamental level: his staff show people how to make floating gardens and fish ponds prevent starvation during the wet season.
ex.t: 但他也在更基础的层面上工作：他的工作人员教人们如何建造浮动花园和鱼塘，以防止雨季发生饥荒。

defs.def: to destroy a building or a group of trees completely by knocking it down 摧毁，夷平（建筑物或树林）

ex.s: Across all participants, those in the beauty group reported an average of 23% higher levels of “transformative and self-transcendent feelings” — such as feeling moved, enlightened and inspired — than the control group.
ex.t: 在所有参与者中，美感组报告的“蜕变性和超越自我的感受”——如感动、受启迪、受鼓舞——平均比对照组高出23%。

defs.def: to make sth equal or similar 使相等；使平等；使相似
to point sth, especially a gun, at sb （尤指用枪）瞄准，对准
to stop rising or falling and remain horizontal （停止升降而）保持水平

ex.s: The report data shows that pleasure reading levels for younger children, ages 2-8, remain largely the same.
ex.t: 报告数据显示，2-8岁儿童的娱乐性阅读水平基本保持不变。

ex.s: By underinflating the front bags, the team allowed the platform carrying the tree to roll up the ramp and out of the hole while staying level, A trailer hauled the tree along as team members removed the airbags from the back of the platform and replaced them in the front.
ex.t: 通过给前部的气囊部分放气，团队让承载树木的平台在滚上斜坡、离开树坑时保持水平；一辆拖车拖着树走，团队成员从平台后部取出气囊并放到前部。

defs.def: to stay at a steady level of development or progress after a period of sharp rises or falls （经过急剧的涨落后）保持平稳发展

ex.t: 大学层面改进教学的努力最近才出现。
